title: NOS unified health system: code, hardware and implementation analysis

scope.requested: Inventory what exists, identify missing integration and profile input, estimate work, and clone/study open-source references for an independent system.
scope.hardware: User confirms base watch only; IMU/RTC/SD/radios and voltage ADC, no optical HR/SpO2, GNSS or barometer add-ons.
scope.work_performed: Read-only production-source analysis; public source clones and report files only. No production implementation, build, flash, device commands or upstream code execution.

baseline.scope: Read-only source analysis, public reference clones and report artifacts. No firmware/source edits or device activity.

assessment: The watch has useful activity, Sports, intake and breathing components, but no unified profile, resting-energy engine or durable health ledger. Setup alone cannot enable passive calories. Software can supply an integrated motion/manual wellness core, while physiological measurements require additional hardware and validation.

setup_flow: Open Health Setup on watch or its temporary local Phone Setup page. Existing setup page currently covers Wi-Fi/essentials, not health.
Explain measured movement versus modeled expenditure; choose units and enter the minimum profile.
Validate values and show missing fields; offer an explicit estimate-model choice or resting-energy override.
Confirm wrist and per-sport hands; offer stride calibration and optional goals.
Review the values and assumptions, save through checked SD banks, and show pending/retry/saved honestly.
Land on one Health overview. Every field stays editable; later edits create effective-dated revisions rather than rewriting past workouts.

architecture.role: One logical typed profile with explicit field owners. nos_prefs remains authoritative for units, timezone, wrist, hands and existing global goals. The health profile owns DOB/age, height, dated decimal mass and energy-model choice/override, with known/unknown, source and revisions.
architecture.storage: Separate paired /watch/health/profile.{0,1}.bin with existing SD lease/lock, CRC, fsync/readback and dirty retry. One-time durable import of known Sports mass; then Sports reads/writes mass through the profile adapter. Preserve old migration source until commit succeeds; never keep two writable mass authorities. Explicit NVS fallback; hal_store(new_key) is not automatically SD-backed.

architecture.role: IMU consumers and collection policy independent of screen; immutable sample snapshots with acquisition timestamps, loss counters and coverage.
architecture.storage: Bounded queue and feature windows. Raw high-rate recording stays a timed diagnostic mode. Explicit deep sleep is a collection gap until a wake/sampling design is implemented.

architecture.role: Typed append-only records for activity, sessions, intake, measurements, sleep estimates and corrections; boot/sequence identity and idempotent replay.
architecture.storage: Async compact SD journal plus minute/day/session indexes. CRC, checkpoints, bounded retention, corrupt-tail recovery, export/restore/delete and migrations. Reuse current primitives; no embedded Django/phone database.

architecture.role: UTC + monotonic + boot/clock segment, trust/uncertainty and local-day boundaries. Handle clock changes, timezone travel and missing time.
architecture.storage: Durable clock mapping/gap events; never manufacture active samples for reboot/deep-sleep downtime.

architecture.role: One rest/net-active/total ledger. Personalized step-distance estimate, workout/step source priority and effective-dated profile/model versions.
architecture.storage: Accrue fractional energy over supported elapsed time; source arbitration per interval. Keep estimates, coverage and historical assumptions visible.

architecture.role: Calibrated movement features, conservative rest/sleep-window estimates, naps and manual corrections; food/water/mindfulness dated records.
architecture.storage: Nonwear/unknown/gaps separate from sleep. Estimate duration only; no validated REM/deep stage claims or physiological stress score.

architecture.role: Activity, Energy, Sports, Breathe, home/widgets/faces and history read a common snapshot. Optional-sensor cards report unavailable.
architecture.storage: UI reads snapshots; no SD scans, sensor activation or profile writes in paint functions.

architecture.role: Versioned units/source/quality/profile/model-aware export and backup/delete. Explicit authorized setup/export and clear event ownership.
architecture.storage: Operational logs record state transitions, budgets, loss/retry/reset reasons without default personal measurements. Full historical companion sync remains an optional follow-on.

energy_contract: Resting energy is a model estimate, not a sensor reading. Use a supported resting-energy equation or explicit override only after profile validation.
Daily total expenditure = modeled resting energy + net active expenditure. Intake is a separate ledger; food minus total expenditure can be shown only with coverage/estimate limitations.
Sports currently reports gross MET expenditure. Convert consistently to net active before adding to modeled rest; reserve its interval so overlapping step energy is replaced, not added again.
Keep elapsed-so-far energy separate from a projected full day. Preserve fractional accumulation, split local-day boundaries and retain the profile/model revision used.
Resting expenditure may be modeled during trusted-clock downtime by an explicit policy; active and sleep observations remain missing. Never fill sensor gaps with fabricated measurements.
Mifflin–St Jeor and MET tables are population models. No precise personal calorie-accuracy claim follows from successful arithmetic or simulator screenshots.

risks.title: Space before features
risks.text: Archived source-exact app is 7,769,440 B in a 7,864,320 B OTA slot: 94,880 B headroom. Internal free RAM was 37,507 B at one observed pose. Budget and reclaim space first; broader refactoring can expand effort. No silent repartition or NVS erasure.

risks.title: Raw logs and battery
risks.text: Source path can emit 50 × 64 × 86,400 = 276,480,000 bytes/day of IMU records if continuously enabled (276.48 MB, excluding overhead). This is a derived volume, not a measured drain cause. Keep causal diagnostics, but bound raw capture and retain compact aggregates normally.

risks.title: Human sleep is not OS sleep
risks.text: Ordinary display-off retains services/IMU; explicit deep sleep parks the board and wakes via GPIO0. Overnight health needs an explicit acquisition policy and visible gaps. Motionless is neither proven sleep nor proven nonwear.

risks.title: Accuracy and time to qualify
risks.text: Current static review proves data paths, not sensor accuracy, classifier accuracy or present battery life. Two badminton recordings cannot validate five sports or opposite wrist/hand combinations. Multi-night/long-session field work adds calendar time.

acceptance_gates: Profile: migrations of existing preferences, unknown fields, decimal weight, units, override/eligibility, effective-date changes, SD absent/full/readback-failure and dirty retry.
Accounting: hand-calculated rest/net-active/total vectors; workout/steps overlap; pause/reboot/idempotence; midnight, DST, timezone travel, forward/backward clock corrections and unknown time.
History/recovery: power failure at each commit phase, damaged tail/bank, card removal/swap, schema upgrade, bounded queues, correction replay, backup/restore and authorized export/delete.

Motion: real-device sampling/units/calibration first; labeled steps, sitting, off-wrist, work/sport motion, overnight and nap diaries; held-out traces. Simulator uses the same replay engine and labels synthetic inputs.

Power: measured screen-off/day/overnight/workout current or controlled discharge with diagnostic modes on/off; low-power transitions and recovery. Existing voltage ADC alone cannot attribute component current.
Integration: source-exact build and simulator/device smoke of all health apps, home/faces and required OS apps, plus SD-write/radio/recording coexistence and long-session soak.

Performance: preserve required 30 fps and blur policy. Prior exact-source baseline missed 87/861 intervals (max 45.504 ms); resolving that pre-existing gap is a separate uncertain release dependency, not a passed health check.

executive_assessment.state: Working activity, workout, heart-measurement and intake components exist; there is not yet one integrated health platform or personal-health onboarding process.
executive_assessment.passive_calorie_issue: The daily service computes steps times a fixed 0.04 kcal. It has no basal/resting energy model or elapsed-day accumulation. Sports weight affects the separate workout MET estimate only.
executive_assessment.main_integration_risk: Workout energy is a gross category estimate; daily step energy and workout energy currently live separately. Adding the two and a daily resting estimate would double count overlapping walking and the resting portion of workout time. Present behavior omits non-step workout energy from the daily Energy screen rather than currently combining those values.
executive_assessment.recommended_scope: Base watch only: reuse live IMU/pedometer, existing recorder ownership, checked preference banks and workout journal. Add profile, shared interval/provenance accounting, durable health history and app integration. Motion-based sleep is explicitly an estimate. HR/SpO2/GNSS stay hardware-gated and are not dependencies of core health.
